description: DPTWP.sav: the PS1 memory card file BESCES-03705 as the PC version stores it next to WTP.exe. Layout from the decompiled save code (CDDHCard, FUN_00478100/00478190/00478200/004782e0) and checked against a save written by the game on 2026-10-19 (header zero, byte-sum checksum, profile defaults). Research: docs/research/2026-10-19-pooh-unlocks/report.md.

unlocks.doc: Quick Play mini-game levels, 1 = unlocked: 5 mini-games x Playground 1-5 (index 5 x game + level - 1); a new profile has 4 (games 0 and 3, Playgrounds 1-2)

adventureBoard.doc: Adventure board reached: 0-2, 255 = never started; Multiplayer offers boards up to this one

movies.doc: Movie Selection entries 1-7 as bits 0-6 (3 once an Adventure has started)

unlock-all.doc: What the game itself grants when a player wins the last Adventure board: every mini-game level and every movie. The Adventure progress stays as it is.

unlock-all-boards.doc: unlock-all, and Multiplayer boards 2 and 3 as well. The same byte is the Adventure progress: a saved Adventure then continues on board 3.
